dynamic_crossing_pedestrian.analysis: Dynamic pedestrian successfully tracked for 6 frames with mean motion of 22.78 px/frame through the roadway corridor. Temporal tracking confirms object persistence and trajectory across the lane.

persistent_sidewalk_pedestrian.analysis: Roadside/sidewalk pedestrian tracked for 1 observations. Corridor gating successfully discriminates this pedestrian from roadway obstacles, suppressing normal false alarms.

ego_vehicle_hood_track.analysis: Ego vehicle hood continuously detected by Faster R-CNN as a 'car'. Corridor y_max cut (880px) cleanly excludes the hood from hazard evaluation.

static_props_limitation.analysis: In spawn-props/scenario-1, custom road obstacles (trash cans, wooden crates) produced zero object tracks. The tracker successfully suppressed transient noise, but cannot track objects that the closed-ontology detector fails to detect in the first place.
